edges.reason: block.timestamp (now) is consumed by randomly() as entropy.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 pseudo-random expression, making it timestamp dependent.
msg.sender is returned by _msgSender().
msg.sender becomes creator and receives the initial supply in the ERC20Token constructor.
msg.sender is hashed into the weak randomness expression.
randomly() increments saslaisgood without an overflow guard.
randomly() output decides the kumquat flag written during transfers.
saslaisgood is read and incremented inside randomly().
_transfer invokes randomly() to set recipient flags.
_transfer enforces require(amount < elephant) only for non-whitelisted senders.
_transfer performs balance subtraction and addition.
_transfer writes kumquat[recipient] based on the random check.
elephant caps the transfer amount in _transfer.
BurnTheFruits overwrites the elephant transfer threshold.
Owner can set elephant arbitrarily, including zero.
creator is compared against sender in _transfer for one-shot flag updates.
creator is compared against owner in _approve for one-shot flag updates.
nokia toggles creator special handling in _transfer.
keyboard toggles creator special handling in _approve.
airplane whitelist bypasses the elephant cap and skips random flag assignment.
kumquat flags propagate between sender and recipient in _transfer.
kumquat[owner] forces the stored allowance to 134 in _approve.
_balances is debited and credited in _transfer.
_allowances is written by _approve.
_approve writes the possibly-forced allowance value.
_mint increases _totalSupply and the account balance.
FruitBowl (onlyOwner) calls _mint.
CheckTheAddress directly writes airplane and kumquat flags for any address.
SetBurnAddress lacks onlyOwner yet writes _owner to picture.
picture is read in SetBurnAddress and assigned to _owner.
_owner is compared to picture and overwritten in SetBurnAddress.
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) delegates to _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership (onlyOwner) clears _owner.
transfer routes through _transfer with _msgSender as sender.
transferFrom routes through _transfer.
approve routes through _approve.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
Ownable constructor assigns _owner and picture from msg.sender.
recipient parameter is used by _transfer.
amount parameter drives the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
spender parameter is used by approve.
sender parameter is used by transferFrom.
owner parameter is used by _approve.
account parameter is used by _mint.
newOwner parameter is used by transferOwnership/_transferOwnership.
addedValue is added to the allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance in decreaseAllowance.
val is written into the airplane whitelist by CheckTheAddress.
val2 is written into the kumquat flag map by CheckTheAddress.
tempval copies elephant inside ViewSomething.
tok holds the allowance value written by _approve.
screen stores the timestamp-derived pseudo-random result.
msgSender caches _msgSender in the Ownable constructor.
c holds the checked arithmetic result in SafeMath.add.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only meaningful as the destination argument of the transfer routine.
amount parameter directly supplies the balance arithmetic performed in _transfer.
spender is consumed by the approval entry point.
sender is the source account handled by transferFrom.
owner parameter keys the allowance mapping in _approve.
account is the mint destination in _mint.
newOwner is the sole argument governing ownership reassignment.
addedValue feeds the SafeMath addition on the allowance.
subtractedValue feeds the SafeMath subtraction on the allowance.
val is stored into airplane only through CheckTheAddress.
val2 is stored into kumquat only through CheckTheAddress.
tempval is a transient copy of elephant with no independent semantics.
tok is a staging variable whose only use is the _allowances write.
screen is the return staging value of the pseudo-random routine.
msgSender is a one-shot cache of msg.sender during initialization.
c is the intermediate arithmetic result inside SafeMath.add.
